title: Annotation Layer (Pen, Eraser, Clear)
description: Add InkCanvas overlay on each PDF page for freehand annotation. Implement toolbar with pen color picker, eraser with adjustable size, and one-click clear button.
action: Overlay transparent InkCanvas on each PDF page Image inside a Grid. Add a toolbar with: pen tool (active by default), color selector (8 preset colors + custom), eraser tool with size slider (5-50px), clear-all button. InkCanvas EditingMode switches between Ink/EraseByStroke/None. DefaultDrawingAttributes.Color bound to selected color. EraserShape size bound to slider.

criteria: XAML contains color selection UI (RadioButton or ComboBox with color values)
XAML contains Slider for eraser size
convergence.verification: dotnet build src/PdfTeachAnnotator && manual test: draw with pen, change color, erase, clear
convergence.definition_of_done: User can draw colored strokes on PDF pages, erase individual strokes with adjustable eraser, and clear all annotations with one click

files.change: Wrap each page Image+InkCanvas in Grid, add toolbar DockPanel at top
SelectedColor, EraserSize, ActiveTool (Pen/Eraser), PenColors collection, ClearCommand
Add ToolbarViewModel property, wire ClearCommand to clear all InkCanvas strokes
IValueConverter for Color to SolidColorBrush binding

implementation: Create ToolbarViewModel: SelectedColor (default Black), EraserSize (default 20), ActiveTool enum (Pen, Eraser), PenColors = [Black, Red, Blue, Green, Orange, Purple, Yellow, White], ClearAllCommand
Modify MainWindow.xaml page ItemTemplate: replace standalone Image with Grid containing Image (bottom) + InkCanvas (top, Background=Transparent, EditingMode bound to ActiveTool)
Add toolbar above ScrollViewer: ToggleButtons for Pen/Eraser, color palette (8 colored rectangles/buttons), Slider for eraser size (5-50, default 20), Button for Clear All
Bind eraser StylusShape dimensions to EraserSize slider value
Implement ClearAll: iterate all InkCanvas instances in visual tree, call Strokes.Clear()
Create ColorToBrushConverter for XAML color bindings

integration: Switch to eraser and erase strokes
success_metrics: Clear removes all annotations from all pages

rationale.chosen_approach: InkCanvas is WPF's built-in inking surface with native stroke collection, editing modes, and serialization support. Overlaying on each page keeps annotations page-aligned.
rationale.tradeoffs: Per-page InkCanvas means managing multiple canvases, but keeps coordinates page-relative which simplifies save/restore

risks: InkCanvas transparency over Image may have hit-testing issues
Many strokes on one page may degrade performance
